standard-dialogue.npc: Ahhh, hello there my friend. You look like you could do with some assistance.
Yes, of course... Here, prepare yourselves!

standard-dialogue.text: Abidor blesses the player, boosting their defence and turning any rotten food into stews.

standard-dialogue.npc: There you go... Right, I must be off now. Good luck with your travels.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-abidor-agai.npc: Ohhh, hello again... sorry my friend, but I have to get going.

kicking-the-player-out-of-morytania.text: A good samaritan teleports you out of Morytania.

kicking-the-player-out-of-morytania.npc: Well, this is no good at all! You'll never survive in Morytania, you'll have to go back.

kicking-the-player-out-of-morytania.text: The player is teleported to Paterdomus.
